data.name: Khawatir
data.gender_notes: Khawatir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic traditions, Khawatir refers to rare, precious pearls given by Allah to His prophets and beloved companions. This name symbolizes the rare and valuable blessings bestowed upon the chosen few. The name Khawatir carries the meaning “Rare, precious pearls” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khawatir usually hope their child will grow to embody rare, precious pearls and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Khawatir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rare, precious pearls.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khawatir total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: خواطر
in_arabic.meaning: الخواطر جمع خاطرة وهي الفكرة أو الشعور الذي يخطر في القلب
in_arabic.long_meaning: الخواطر جمع خاطرة، وهي الفكرة أو الشعور الذي يخطر في القلب. يعتبر اسم خواطر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني عميقة في اللغة العربية، حيث يشير إلى الأفكار والمشاعر التي تطرأ على القلب. في القرآن الكريم، نجد أن الخواطر ترتبط بالشعور الداخلي والتفكير العميق. اسم خواطر يعكس الجانب الروحي والتفكيري للإنسان.

in_urdu.name: خواطر
in_urdu.meaning: خواطر کا مطلب ہے دل میں آنے والے خیالات یا احساسات
in_urdu.long_meaning: خواطر جمع خاطرة، اردو میں اس کا مطلب ہے دل میں آنے والے خیالات یا احساسات۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جہاں اس کا مطلب ہے سوچنا، غور کرنا۔ اسلامی روایت میں، خواطر کو ایک ایسے تصور کے طور پر سمجھا جاتا ہے جو انسان کے دل اور دماغ سے جڑا ہوا ہے، جیسا کہ قرآن میں بیان کیا گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ख़वातिर
in_hindi.meaning: ख़वातिर का अर्थ है दिल में आने वाले विचार या भावनाएँ
in_hindi.long_meaning: ख़वातिर एक ऐसा नाम है जिसका अर्थ है दिल में आने वाले विचार या भावनाएँ। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जहाँ इसका अर्थ है सोच, विचार करना। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, ख़वातिर नाम का उपयोग आध्यात्मिक और बौद्धिक पहलुओं को दर्शाने के लिए किया जाता है, जैसा कि कुरआन में बताया गया है।

in_pashto.name: خواطر
in_pashto.meaning: خواطر دى چه معنا يې دى په زړه كې راكېدونكي افكارونه يا احساسات
in_pashto.long_meaning: خواطر په پښتو کې دى چه معنا يې دى په زړه كې راكېدونكي افكارونه يا احساسات. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چیرته چې د دې مطلب دی فکر کول، غور کول. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، خواطر د یو مفهوم په توګه ګڼل کیږي چې د انسان د زړه او ذهن سره تړلی دی، لکه څنګه چې په قرآن کې بیان شوی دی.

in_english.name: Khawatir
in_english.meaning: Khawatir means thoughts, ideas, or feelings that occur in the heart
in_english.long_meaning: Khawatir is an Arabic name that refers to thoughts, ideas, or feelings that occur in the heart. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'kh-ṭ-r', it signifies thinking, pondering, or considering. In Islamic tradition, Khawatir is associated with internal reflections and contemplation, as mentioned in the Quran. The name symbolizes the intellectual and spiritual aspects of a person.

data.cultural_impact: The name Khawatir holds a rich and prestigious cultural significance in the Islamic world. It is believed that the term was first used during the time of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his companions to refer to the fine and exceptional people or items that were considered rare and valuable. Khawatir can be likened to pearls, which are highly sought after for their beauty and rarity. In the Islamic context, these pearls represent the favored individuals who have received Allah's blessings and guidance, making them incomparable and valuable.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Khawatir represents the rare and precious blessings bestowed upon the chosen few by Allah. This name holds a deep significance for Muslims as it serves as a reminder of the immense value and worth of individual devotion and obedience to Allah. As mentioned in various Hadiths, being among the blessed few, or the elect, in the eyes of Allah has significant spiritual rewards and benefits, which are beyond the realm of human understanding. Therefore, striving to connect spiritually with Allah and seeking His blessings and guidance is a continuous pursuit for Muslims, and the name Khawatir serves as a powerful motif and reminder of this important goal.
